description: This file defines Swagger annotations for the SelfUser API resource in the Fineract project. It contains classes that specify request and response schemas used for API documentation and possibly for request/response validation.

classes.name: SelfUserApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes that define the request and response payload schemas for the SelfUser API endpoints, annotated for Swagger documentation.

classes.name: SelfUserApiResourceSwagger.PutSelfUserRequest
classes.description: Schema class representing the request payload for updating self user information, specifically password fields.

classes.name: SelfUserApiResourceSwagger.PutSelfUserResponse
classes.description: Schema class representing the response payload after updating self user information, including user identifiers and change details.

classes.name: SelfUserApiResourceSwagger.PutSelfUserResponse.PutSelfUserChanges
classes.description: Nested schema class within the response, detailing specific changes such as the encoded password.
